Thank you, Jeffpierrealix, for sharing your experience with us. We're delighted to know you had a positive visit. Your feedback is truly appreciated by our team.

⚠️ **UNSATISFIED WITH MY EXPERIENCE AT SKYLAKE ANIMAL VETS — PLEASE READ BEFORE BRINGING YOUR PET**

I brought my 19-pound Yorkie-Shih Tzu, Lucy, to Skylake Animal Vets because she was having a dental issue. Unfortunately, I left extremely disappointed with both the customer service and the veterinary care we received.

I was charged **$53 for a first-time consultation**, even though the clinic's website/profile advertised a **free exam for new customers with the purchase of a product**. I purchased a $30 dental mouth-rinse product for Lucy, so I expected the consultation to qualify under the advertised promotion. I would like clarification as to why I was charged the $53.

I was also concerned about the way the examination was handled. The veterinarian, **Dr. Sarah D'Argenio**, appeared to perform a very brief examination. I did not feel that Lucy received a thorough evaluation, and I specifically noticed that her ears were not examined. Most of the attention appeared to be focused on her teeth.

I was then told that Lucy had a heart murmur and that, before she could have her dental procedure, she would need additional testing, including blood work and a cardiac evaluation. I was given an estimate of approximately **$1,570** for these services. As a pet owner, I understand that appropriate testing may sometimes be medically necessary before anesthesia, but I felt the cost was extremely high and that the options and reasoning were not adequately explained to me.

I also asked whether anything could be prescribed or recommended to help Lucy's dental problem while we were deciding what to do. I felt that I was not given adequate options or an explanation of what I could safely do for her at home.

My interaction with **Teresa Raymond** was also disappointing. When I asked whether payment plans were available, I was told, *“No, you have to pay cash,”* in a manner that I found unnecessarily rude and dismissive. I also did not appreciate being expected to physically hold Lucy during the examination rather than feeling that the staff was providing appropriate assistance.

Because I was uncomfortable with the experience and the proposed cost, I decided to get a second opinion at another veterinary clinic. **I am very happy that I did.** Lucy's blood work came back normal, and she is scheduled to have her dental extractions on Monday.

I am requesting that Skylake Animal Vets review my charges and **consider refunding the $53 consultation fee**, particularly because of the advertised new-customer promotion and my purchase of the dental product.

I also strongly recommend that the clinic review how its staff communicates with pet owners, how examination findings and treatment options are explained, and how promotional pricing is represented to new customers.

Finally, the aquarium in the lobby appeared to have significant mold/algae buildup and did not look properly maintained. If a veterinary facility presents an aquarium in its lobby, I would expect it to be clean and properly cared for.

This review reflects **my personal experience**. I encourage other pet owners to ask questions, request an itemized estimate, understand exactly what testing is being recommended and why, and consider getting a second opinion if they are uncomfortable with a diagnosis or treatment plan.

**I would not personally return to this clinic based on my experience.**

A Heartfelt Thank You
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Skylake Animal Hospital and the incredible care they provide to Rango. From the moment he walks through their doors, I know he is in the best possible hands.
I especially want to recognize Dr. Cooper, who has gone above and beyond for Rango. His knowledge, attentiveness, compassion, and genuine love for his patients are truly exceptional. He takes the time to listen, explain everything, and make sure Rango receives the very best care possible—day or night.
What makes Dr. Cooper so special to me is that somewhere along the way, our veterinarian-client relationship became something much more meaningful. Dr. Cooper has become a dear friend, and I feel incredibly fortunate to have him not only caring for Rango, but also in our lives. His kindness and dedication have meant more to me than I can put into words.
The entire team provides remarkable round-the-clock care and attention, and knowing that Rango is being watched over so carefully gives me tremendous peace of mind. They treat him like family, and that means everything to me.
Thank you, Dr. Cooper, and the entire team, for loving and caring for my very special boy. We are incredibly grateful for each and every one of you. ❤️🐾

My name is Ray Mazuolis. I do have my two Jack russells registered with your hospital. This morning I brought one of them by name Mika. I did sign the charges without looking much at it because I was in shock because my dog I thought was dying. But when I came back home I realized that the charges are just outrageous. Copy of the bill will be attached. X-ray charges with consultation fees were already exceeding $400. Then it was $97 added as a stat fee radiology consultation. Which I never asked for. Even a Doctor Sara D'Argenio told me to go home and my results will be emailed me without certain time because it wasn't really important, because the dog was recovering already. I would be gone home but the doctor Sara told me to wait until she finish up preparing my medication. When the medication was ready the a radiology results came in. So why are you charging me $97 for STAT consultation when it's not. On the top of everything, your hospital haven't done nothing to my dog to stop shaking, hyperventilating and no explanation what's going on. I should just stayed home and my dog would recover by itself as it did this now. And the most ridiculous thing I ever seen is $44 charge for taking dogs blood pressure. Are you kidding me???????? Even in the humans hospital doctor's office the blood pressure measure is included in the consultation fee. Why are you trying to rip off your own customers???????? I am expecting to get a refund on those $97,$44. Also, $108 as promised by your management over the phone. Just think twice going to this animal medical facility thinking that everybody love your animals over there. No, they just think about money in your pockets

Excellent service

If I could give Sky Lake Animal Hospital more than five stars, I would do so without hesitation. This is, without question, one of the finest veterinary hospitals I have ever had the privilege of visiting. From the moment you walk through the doors, you are greeted with warmth, kindness, and a level of professionalism that immediately lets you know your beloved pet is in the very best hands.
The customer service is nothing short of extraordinary. Every member of the team is genuinely compassionate, attentive, knowledgeable, and dedicated to providing exceptional care. They take the time to listen, answer every question with patience, and make you feel like family. It is evident that everyone at Sky Lake Animal Hospital shares the same mission: to provide the highest level of care while treating every pet with love, dignity, and respect.
A very special and heartfelt recognition goes to Dr. Savannah Branch. She is truly one of a kind. Her knowledge, professionalism, and attention to detail are remarkable, but what makes her exceptional is her compassion. She has a rare gift for connecting with both animals and their families, bringing comfort, confidence, and genuine kindness during every visit. She treats every patient as if they were her own, and that level of dedication cannot be taught—it comes from the heart. Dr. Branch is not only an outstanding veterinarian but also an extraordinary human being whose compassion and integrity make a lasting impact on everyone she meets.
Sky Lake Animal Hospital has earned my complete trust, admiration, and highest recommendation. In today's world, it is rare to find a team so devoted to excellence and so passionate about what they do. Thank you to Dr. Savannah Branch and every member of the staff for your unwavering commitment, your outstanding customer service, and the incredible care you provide each and every day. You are a true blessing to our community and to every family fortunate enough to walk through your doors.
Respectfully,
Olaf
